The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled '''Fuel Station Ergo''' was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] station.

==Description==
[[File:ergocontrol.png|thumb|left|The panel in the control room which operates the rotating arm.]]
Ergo was a fuel station orbiting some [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Controlled by the Empire, it supplied ships, even [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ones. In addition to the standard strength of [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial commando/Legends|commandos]], the station also employed [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] mercenaries and thugs.

The station had a circular layout, surrounded by a circular corridor with six circular nodes; areas of the station were full of [[Power Generating Unit|PGUs]]. The northern and northwestern nodes had circular stairwells that led to two [[hangar/Legends|docking bays]] that accommodate ships; a rotating arm or corridor, controlled by the main control room, connected the bays with the main base. The northeastern node housed a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] whereas the southeastern node led to the higher level with the fuel room; a rotating walkway from a central "island" connected four circular balconies around the area; the northwestern one led to a corridor to the main control room, at the higher level.<ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

==History==
Sometime in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[smuggler ship (Ergo)|smuggler ship]] bound to rendezvous with the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], was being supplied in the station. [[Kyle Katarn]], was hoping to discover the secret location of the ''[[Arc Hammer]]'' facility, known only by the ''Executor''; the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Mission to Fuel Station Ergo|boarded the station and hijacked]] the smuggler ship, which eventually took him to the ''Executor''.<ref name="DF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that Ergo was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a military code name.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
